title: Torch
summary: Light source that adds 1d4 Fire while lit.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple Light one-handed club. 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength. No listed proficient weapon action.
fields.Light: Equipping automatically lights it. While lit, hits add 1d4 Fire and contact can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
